sloka: लाजैश्चैव तथा पुष्पैर्धूपैश्चैव सुगन्धिभिः ।पूजयित्वा महाबाहू राघवः पुष्पकं तदा ।। ७.४१.१३ ॥
transliteration: lājaiścaiva tathā puṣpairdhūpaiścaiva sugandhibhiḥ ।pūjayitvā mahābāhū rāghavaḥ puṣpakaṁ tadā ।। 7.41.13 ॥

translations.english: Then, the mighty-armed Rama worshipped the Pushpaka chariot with parched grains, flowers, and fragrant incense.
